items.title: Harry Fairconnetue Interview, 1962-11-11
items.q: Wasn't that when we played that picnic that Sunday with O'Geece

ctx.x: We found a short way to get there by going to the best. Yeah, that's where it was at Ditto. Oh, that was for land. Yeah, out there Ditto.

Wasn't that when we played that picnic that Sunday with O'Geece, when he had one string on his base, no back on his base, and took his shoes off, soon he got in this fabulous place. Bear Feeder stand by on the base. Don't you remember that, Alan?
Yeah, I remember that, but I don't know what place it was.
